name: io.github.theluckystrike/fdic-bank-health-financials-mcp
title: FDIC Bank Health & Financials MCP
description: FDIC bank insurance status, Call Report financials, Tier 1 capital, failed banks, and branch lookup.

tools.name: fdic_bank_search
tools.description: Search FDIC-insured US banks by name, state, city, ZIP code, or FDIC CERT number. Returns active insurance status, CERT number, headquarters, charter class, total assets, total deposits, equity capital, net income, ROA, ROE, office count, and website.

name.description: Bank name or keyword, e.g. "JPMorgan", "Silicon Valley", "First Republic".

state.description: 2-letter US state code or full state name, e.g. "NY" or "California".

active_only.description: Only return currently active FDIC-insured banks. Default true.

tools.name: fdic_bank_financials
tools.description: Retrieve quarterly FDIC Call Report financial health metrics for a bank by CERT number (or bank name + optional state): total assets, total and domestic deposits, insured vs uninsured deposits and uninsured share %, equity capital, Tier 1 capital, CET1 ratio, Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio, YTD net income, ROA, ROE, net interest margin, efficiency ratio, and noncurrent loans %.

cert.description: FDIC Certificate (CERT) number, e.g. 628 for JPMorgan Chase Bank.

name.description: Bank name to resolve if CERT is not known.

state.description: Optional state to narrow name resolution.

quarters.description: Number of recent quarterly Call Reports to return (1-12). Default 4.

tools.name: fdic_failed_banks
tools.description: Search the official FDIC Failed Bank List from 1934 to the present by bank name, state, or year range, or omit filters to list the most recent US bank failures. Returns failure date, location, assets and deposits at failure, estimated Deposit Insurance Fund (DIF) cost, resolution type, and CERT number.

name.description: Failed bank name or keyword, e.g. "Signature", "Silicon Valley", "Small Business".

state.description: 2-letter US state code or full state name.

tools.name: fdic_bank_branches
tools.description: Find physical branch locations of FDIC-insured banks by CERT number, bank name, ZIP code, city, or state. Returns branch name, street address, county, main-office indicator, service type code, and latitude/longitude.

cert.description: FDIC CERT number of the bank.

state.description: 2-letter US state code or full state name.
